description: Deckwatch container runtime — CPU, memory, I/O, threads, restarts, OOM events, PSI pressure, and plugin execution metrics for debugging performance and stability.
title: Deckwatch Infrastructure

panels.title: CPU Usage
panels.description: Current CPU core usage (5m rate)

panels.title: Memory Working Set
panels.description: Current memory working set

panels.title: Threads
panels.description: Number of threads in the container

panels.title: Restarts
panels.description: Total container restarts

panels.title: OOM Kills
panels.description: Total OOM kill events

panels.title: CPU Throttle %
panels.description: Percentage of CFS periods that were throttled

panels.title: CPU Usage vs Requests & Limits
panels.description: CPU core usage over time with request and limit reference lines

panels.title: CPU Throttling
panels.description: CFS throttled periods ratio over time

panels.title: CPU Load Average (10s)
panels.description: Container-level CPU load average over 10 second windows

panels.title: Memory Usage vs Requests & Limits
panels.description: Memory working set, RSS, and cache with request and limit reference lines

panels.title: Memory Breakdown
panels.description: Active file, inactive file, kernel usage, and max usage over time

panels.title: Memory Failures
panels.description: Memory allocation failure counter by type (pgfault, pgmajfault)

panels.title: OOM Events
panels.description: Cumulative OOM kill events over time

panels.title: Filesystem Read/Write Throughput
panels.description: Bytes read and written per second to the container filesystem

panels.title: Filesystem IOPS
panels.description: Read and write operations per second

panels.title: Block I/O Usage
panels.description: Block device I/O bytes per second by operation

panels.title: CPU Pressure
panels.description: PSI CPU stalled and waiting time rates — tasks blocked on CPU scheduling

panels.title: Memory Pressure
panels.description: PSI memory stalled and waiting time rates — tasks blocked on memory allocation or reclaim

panels.title: I/O Pressure
panels.description: PSI I/O stalled and waiting time rates — tasks blocked on disk or network I/O

panels.title: Loaded Plugins
panels.description: Number of currently loaded WASM plugins

panels.title: Plugin Executions/s
panels.description: Total plugin execution rate across all plugins and operations

panels.title: Plugin Error Rate
panels.description: All plugin errors per second (WASM failures + reported errors + fetch failures)

panels.title: Plugin p99 Latency
panels.description: p99 execution duration across all plugin operations

panels.title: Load Failures
panels.description: Total plugin load failures (fetch errors, disabled plugins excluded)

panels.title: K8s Resource Failures
panels.description: Plugin-emitted Kubernetes resource apply failures (CRD missing, RBAC, etc.)

panels.title: Plugin Execution Rate by Plugin & Operation
panels.description: Execution rate broken down by plugin name, operation (apply/provision/deprovision), and status

panels.title: Plugin Execution Latency p95 by Plugin
panels.description: p95 execution duration per plugin and operation

panels.title: Plugin Errors by Type
panels.description: Error rate broken down by plugin and error type (fetch_failed, apply_failed, reported_error, dependency_cycle, sa_conflict, etc.)

panels.title: Plugin K8s Resource Applies
panels.description: Rate of plugin-emitted Kubernetes resource applications by kind and status
